items.actClause: AN ACT in relation to allowing Charles McDonough to file a request for Tier II status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4295

TITLE OF BILL:  An act in relation to allowing Charles McDonough to
file a request for Tier II status in the New York state and local
employees' retirement system

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL: To allow Charles McDonough to apply
for Tier II retirement status

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1 states that Charles McDonough who has been employed by the
Town of Grand Island since October 29, 1979, who is a Tier III member
of the New York state and local employees retirement system was
employed by the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation
at the Beaver Island state park in Erie County beginning June 24, 1975
and ending in November of 1975.

Section 2 states all past service costs shall be borne by the State of
New York.

Section 3 is the effective date.

JUSTIFICATION: Mr. McDonough worked for the Office of Parks,
Recreation, and Historic Preservation at the Beaver Island State Park
for the summer and fall of 1975. For reasons not ascribable to his own
negligence, he was not able to properly enroll in the New York state
and local employees retirement system during that employment.  This
legislation would correct this error and properly allow Charles
McDonough to be a Tier II member of the State retirement system.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: $103,000

EFFECTIVE DATE: This bill shall take effect immediately.

summary: Relates to allowing Charles McDonough to file a request for Tier II status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system based upon employment with the state of New York at Beaver Island state park.
